paper_metadata.title: Improving the Mechanical Properties of Ti-6Al-4V Alloy by Equal Channel Angular Pressing
paper_metadata.journal: Nanostructured Materials by High-Pressure Severe Plastic Deformation

It was established that structure refinement by ECAP significantly improved the strength of this alloy.
Up to 40% of improvement in strength has been obtained in ECAP-processed Ti-6Al-4V alloy, compared with its annealed state.
